environment: Local Expo web, 430 x 932 CSS pixels, owned QA fixture; not physical iPhone testing

visualComparisons.result: Shared header, navigation and plus are present. Data-dependent fixture content differs; one QA Circle is not evidence of a missing design. No visual sign-off for all states.
Original card artwork and setup row are represented. Only one unissued QA card tested; multi-card stack interactions and issued/spender states untested.

Shared/All bills tabs, Overview/By week, monthly summary, import action, plus and shared navigation are present. Planning copy differs from intended funded design; provider completion remains separate.
Four colored creation rows closely follow original. App adds an explicit close control. Menu dismissed after navigation transition; timing not measured.

Artwork, people picker and three settings are implemented. App adds persistent bottom navigation absent from original frame; increased vertical spacing pushes anonymous setting below initial viewport. Resolve intended shell/insets before redesigning.

sourceInspections.finding: Sign-in/create-account switching and field errors exist; no reset-password action or recovery/verification states. Existing Figma alternatives need canonical reconciliation before implementation.
Only source/account steps. Detection, review and selection are not implemented; explicit unconnected-build panels replace the rest of the intended flow.
Connect bank account is disabled; refresh rechecks entry status. This is a real integration gap, not a missing Figma design.
Several security/settings actions call an unavailable dialog. Existing Figma recovery and security states need explicit mapping rather than new generic screens.
Amount/review planning is present, but review proceeds to bank setup; no transfer submission. Retain consent boundary while later restoring provider-backed flow.
Contribution review and own accepted agreement checks exist. Actual funding unavailable; screen does not implement settlement states.
Substantive recovery already exists; do not rebuild it again. Appearance picker, people, settings and saved draft are implemented.
Stack expansion exists, but Finish setup is always shown for the first card; provider-ready alternatives need review once integrated.
Shared/All tabs, data-dependent empty states and original import asset are implemented.

limits: This is a sample comparison, not exhaustive route/state verification.
No real financial actions or user-data changes were performed.
